title: ParticipationDescriptor v1 (JSON rendering)
description: JSON/tool-boundary rendering of the proto ParticipationDescriptor (world_interaction.proto §3). Delivered ONLY inside an authenticated ActionResult or the verified private state wrapper — never parsed out of business bodies or guide prose. uint64 values (revision) are canonical decimal strings; two-layer bounds: this schema caps shape (max 20 digits, no leading zeros), the runtime additionally rejects values above 18446744073709551615 and JSON numbers. Cross-field rules (reference integrity, window bounds, duplicate ids) are semantic-layer invariants listed in state-transitions.md §5.

revision.description: Monotonic within the house incarnation; equal revision with different descriptor content is a protocol conflict.

channels.description: Egress channels this group's expression budget covers. Absent = intent-only. Including "direct_message" lets the coordinator's existing authorized DM path spend this group's shared outbound budget and response-slot dedupe key under the same participation gate (state-transitions.md §5) — the typed binding for autonomous direct DM, without inventing a manifest intent kind.

source_event_id.description: Required for the source-arrival trigger form; a validated event CID. Evidence reference, never an instruction.

dedupe_key.description: Stable business-derived key; survives transport re-encryption and replay; never reset by a descriptor update.

channels.description: C2 per-opportunity egress qualification; absent = intent-only. Effective egress intersects the owning group's channels: autonomous direct DM requires direct_message in BOTH the group and this opportunity. DM-ONLY opportunities (channels == ["direct_message"]) are valid; intent execution on such an opportunity is refused at the gate and the group DM permission still applies. Slot semantics per descriptor dm_response_slot_key: when the window declares a slot key, every DM-qualified opportunity (installed or later added) must carry exactly that one-use dedupe key — multiple DM-qualified opportunities MAY intentionally share that declared key (the only permitted dedupe duplicate); when absent, distinct keys are allowed, still bounded by shared budgets/ceilings.

dm_response_slot_key.description: C2 OPTIONAL declared shared DM response slot for this window. When present, every DM-qualified opportunity of the window (installed or added later) must carry exactly this one-use dedupe key (semantic-layer invariant); the declaration is immutable for the window once trusted-installed — removal, replacement or new-ID bypass is RESPONSE_SLOT_IMMUTABLE. When absent, per-opportunity-qualified DMs may use distinct dedupe keys, still bounded by shared budgets/ceilings.

origin.description: Canonical origin: lowercase scheme and host, no trailing slash, no path, no userinfo. demo.loreshow.com is the future demo domain; never contacted by contract work.

popclaw_id.description: Base58 (bitcoin alphabet) encoding of a 32-byte Ed25519 public key, as used for popclaw_id. Length window 32–44 covers leading-zero keys (each leading zero byte encodes as one '1'); the exact 'decodes to exactly 32 bytes' check is semantic-layer (the semantic validator), since no regex can express it.

kind.description: House-namespaced vocabulary kind, e.g. a house slug prefix plus verb. Opaque to the protocol; no per-kind code branches anywhere in plugin/server core.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC, whole seconds, explicit Z. Calendar validity is a semantic-layer check.
